messages:
alert-bot: SECURITY_ALERT: Unusual IAM binding change detected for project redwood-prod. Elevated role granted to serviceAccount:analytics-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-20T02:07:14Z :rotating_light:
liz (sec-oncall): saw the alert, pulling audit log now. creating war-room.
raj (eng-oncall): joining — can you paste the log line?
liz (sec-oncall): pasted snippet: ```{"protoPayload": {"methodName":"SetIamPolicy","resourceName":"projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/analytics-runner@...","principalEmail":"ci-bot@partner-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com","policyDelta": "+roles/editor"}}```
maria (sre): wow editor on analytics runner. That gives broad permissions. Is this a deploy or a compromise?
kevin (cloudsec): not a deploy we triggered. CI bot shouldn't have set IAM. Could be pipeline creds leaked or misconfigured Terraform apply.
liz (sec-oncall): containment steps: 1) remove newly-added binding 2) rotate service account keys / disable tokens 3) snapshot project audit logs + export to secure bucket 4) block CI runner IP if external 5) create forensic snapshots of GCE/containers touched. Agree?
raj (eng-oncall): on it. Removing binding now: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member="serviceAccount:analytics-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles.editor"`
alert-bot: deploy-bot noticed a config change to infra-repo at refs/heads/main 02:04:59Z — commit b3c4f.. (author: ci-bot).
kevin (cloudsec): that commit looks suspicious. Grab the CI job history and who had tokens. Also check KMS decrypt calls around same time.
liz (sec-oncall): Maria, can you snapshot CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs and push to secure bucket redwood-secure-evidence. Mark retention + lock.
maria (sre): started export -> bucket redwood-secure-evidence/evidence-1767001234. Also took GKE pod snapshots for analytics namespace.
raj (eng-oncall): rotated analytics-runner SA keys, disabled any user-managed keys, added short-lived workload identity mapping instead.
kevin (cloudsec): I see KMS decrypt requests at 02:06:30Z from the CI bot IP targeting projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/data/cryptoKeys/main-key. Suspect exfil attempt. I've rotated the key cryptoKeyVersions and triggered rekey.
liz (sec-oncall): good. Also enable additional audit logging for KMS and IAM and raise alert thresholds.
alert-bot: INC created: INC-9872RBAC — "unapproved iam binding + possible ci-bot compromise". Pager duty: sec-oncall.
kevin (cloudsec): evidence collected: list of commits, CI job logs, KMS decrypt logs, IAM policy delta. Uploading to case management.
raj (eng-oncall): quick mitigation config I applied: deny on GCP-Folder level for `serviceAccount:ci-bot@partner-ci` to setIamPolicy via org policy until we triage.
liz (sec-oncall): assign roles: Incident Commander: liz, Forensics: kevin, Containment/Infra: raj, Communications: oscar, SRE support: maria.
oscar (oncall-night): copying comms: notify legal + trust, draft notice for customers if needed.
kevin (cloudsec): triage notes: possible vector: leaked CI service account key in partner repo, or compromised partner CI. We need to coordinate with partner security.
maria (sre): performance impact: no production degradation yet. Analytics pipelines paused by us (they use that SA).
raj (eng-oncall): created temporary policy to block SA from access to KMS key: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:analytics-runner@... --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
liz (sec-oncall): preserve timeline in the ticket. First observed at 02:07:14Z, binding set at ~02:04:59Z, KMS decrypt ~02:06:30Z. Next steps: 1) forensic review, 2) partner outreach, 3) rotate any downstream credentials, 4) run vuln triage for infra as code.
oscar (oncall-night): I'm taking communications and will prepare the incident channel post + legal ping. Handoff at 04:00Z to night SEC oncall.
liz (sec-oncall): handoff to oscar at 04:00Z noted. I'll stay until 03:30Z to finalize evidence uploads.
kevin (cloudsec): leaving detailed search queries in the ticket: KMS decrypt logs filter `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"` and IAM delta filter `protoPayload.methodName=\"SetIamPolicy\"`.
raj (eng-oncall): adding playbook snippet to ticket for rollback and postmortem.
liz (sec-oncall): closing immediate war-room. New actions assigned in INC-9872RBAC ticket. Will follow up with postmortem timeline and remediation checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:
